WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'a prestigious award in sports') AS ref_vec_0,

PlayerAwards AS (
    SELECT playerID, award, year, pos, distance(awards_players.note_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM awards_players
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

AllStarStats AS (
    SELECT pa.playerID, pa.award, pa.year, pa.pos, distance, 
             ast.games_played, ast.points, ast.assists, ast.rebounds
      FROM PlayerAwards pa
      JOIN player_allstar ast ON toString(pa.playerID) = toString(ast.playerID) AND pa.year = ast.season_id
      WHERE ast.points > 500
),

TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT ast.playerID, ast.award, ast.year, ast.pos, ast.distance,
             t.tmID, t.won, t.lost, (t.won - t.lost) AS win_diff
      FROM AllStarStats ast
      JOIN players_teams pt ON toString(ast.playerID) = toString(pt.playerID) AND ast.year = pt.year
      JOIN teams t ON toString(pt.tmID) = toString(t.tmID) AND pt.year = t.year
      WHERE t.playoff = 'Y' AND win_diff > 20
)

SELECT DISTINCT playerID
FROM TeamPerformance
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 1;

v_filtered AS (
    SELECT

        distance(Venue_description_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM Venue

        *,

    FROM Season
    WHERE Season_description_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Season featuring intense competition AND remarkable players')

),

    SELECT
        m.Match_Id AS Match_Id,
        v.Venue_Name AS Venue_Name,
        c.City_Name AS City_Name

        Match m

    SELECT
        s.Season_Id AS Season_Id,
        s.Season_Year AS Season_Year,

  vm.Match_Id AS Match_Id,
  vm.Venue_Name AS Venue_Name,
  sd.Season_Year AS Season_Year
FROM
  VenueMatches vm

ORDER BY
